question: In which Indian state are the rivers Tirap and Noa located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Siang, Noa, Tirap and Kameng are rivers found in the state of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The major river of Arunachal Pradesh is the Brahmaputra and all the rivers are its tributaries.
 
• Kameng river formerly known as Bhareli river and Jia Bhoreli in Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
